<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target alkene, gives a β‑hydroxy‑trimethylsilyl precursor (Peterson elimination). The forward reaction breaks a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic C‑O (hydroxyl) bond and forms a C=C double bond. Using the available functional‑group list, we search for templates with those broken/formed groups.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
